---
title: "Session 4 · Bias & effect: can we trust it, how big is it?"
subtitle: "Week 4 · Saturday · online, 19:30–22:30 (3 hours, 15-minute break)"
---

**Date:** 21/11/2026

## Agenda

- Recap quiz on Session 3 (10 min)
- 4.1  Bias, confounding and causation (40 min)
- 4.2  Measuring disease and association, with a live 2x2 demo (25 min)
- Break (15 min), then two 2x2 calculations together (15 min)
- 4.3  Beyond single studies: tests, meta-analysis, appraisal (30 min)
- Proposal builder 4: exposure, outcomes, biases (40 min), then wrap-up (5 min)

## Timetable

| Start | Clock* | Min | Segment |
|:----|:----|---:|:------------------------------------------------------------|
| 0:00 | 19:30 | 10 | Recap quiz |
| 0:10 | 19:40 | 40 | **4.1 Bias, confounding and causation:** random error vs bias, selection, information, confounding (by indication), effect modification, how designs fight bias, validity, reverse causation, Bradford Hill; spot-the-bias quiz |
| 0:50 | 20:20 | 25 | **4.2 Measuring disease and association:** prevalence vs incidence, risk, 2×2, RR / OR / RD / NNT, OR vs RR; **live 2×2 calculator demo** |
| 1:15 | 20:45 | 15 | BREAK |
| 1:30 | 21:00 | 15 | Whole-class exercise: two 2×2 calculations, answers by poll |
| 1:45 | 21:15 | 30 | **4.3 Beyond single studies:** diagnostic accuracy (sens/spec, PPV & prevalence, ROC), systematic reviews & forest plots, heterogeneity, risk-of-bias tools, "are the conclusions supported?" (whole-class task) |
| 2:15 | 21:45 | 40 | **Proposal builder 4:** outcomes, then modelled live (exposure & comparator, outcomes, main biases & mitigation); each participant drafts their own (finished as homework); three volunteers share in the chat |
| 2:55 | 22:25 | 5 | Wrap-up |

\*Times are relative to the start of the session; the clock column shows Vietnam time for the online 19:30–22:30 session. All exercises are done by the whole class together (no groups). **[DS]** = course-dataset content (FLUID-ICU analysis and manuscript writing).
